'''Frank Lamantia Final Mains of Course''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Frank Lamantia]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-299">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/299 Final Mains of Course], DeckTech (Frank "FrankLamanti" Lamantia, 28 August 1999). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/299/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/299/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018231823/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/299/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Final Mains of Course'''
* '''Author:''' Frank "FrankLamanti" Lamantia
* '''Published:''' August 28, 1999
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Big drains and force choke.

=== Strategy ===

Same strategy as my past Mains Of Course decks mostly.  Use Bomarrs for added drains.  Beatdown as necessary.  Get a high power dude at Tosche Station ASAP for big activation.  Coruscant is for late game drains.
